PUBLIC_SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.title: Sensitive resource permits public access
PUBLIC_SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.why_it_matters: The resource is marked sensitive and its configuration explicitly allows public access.
PUBLIC_SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.potential_impact: Anyone who can reach the resource endpoint may be able to read sensitive data, depending on the real provider's enforcement.
PUBLIC_SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.recommended_action: Confirm whether public access is intended. If not, disable public access and re-verify with a fresh scan.
limitations: Synthetic schema; real provider enforcement is not modelled.

UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_ACCESS_SENSITIVE.title: Public access state unknown for sensitive resource
UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_ACCESS_SENSITIVE.why_it_matters: The public_access field is missing for a sensitive resource, so exposure cannot be assessed.
UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_ACCESS_SENSITIVE.potential_impact: The resource may or may not be exposed. The missing field is not evidence of safety.
UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_ACCESS_SENSITIVE.recommended_action: Supply the public_access value from the authoritative configuration and rescan.
limitations: Absence of a field is recorded as UNKNOWN, never as SAFE.

PUBLIC_NON_SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.title: Non-sensitive resource permits public access
PUBLIC_NON_SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.why_it_matters: A publicly accessible resource increases the surface area of the environment even when it is not marked sensitive.
PUBLIC_NON_SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.potential_impact: Data stored in or served by this resource may be reachable without authentication.
PUBLIC_NON_SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.recommended_action: Confirm the resource is meant to be public and that it holds no sensitive data.
limitations: Sensitivity classification comes from the input, not from content inspection.

IAM_EXCESS_PRIVILEGE.title: Identity is granted actions beyond its declared requirements
IAM_EXCESS_PRIVILEGE.why_it_matters: Granted actions outside the declared required-action list increase what the identity could do if it were misused.
IAM_EXCESS_PRIVILEGE.potential_impact: Excess permissions can widen the effect of a compromised credential or a coding mistake.
IAM_EXCESS_PRIVILEGE.recommended_action: Compare the granted actions with real usage and narrow the policy to declared requirements.
limitations: The declared required-action list may be incomplete.
Full IAM policy evaluation is not performed.

IAM_WILDCARD_SCOPE.title: Identity holds wildcard action or resource scope
IAM_WILDCARD_SCOPE.why_it_matters: A wildcard action or resource grants an open-ended scope that is hard to audit.
IAM_WILDCARD_SCOPE.potential_impact: Wildcard grants can reach resources and actions that were never intended.
IAM_WILDCARD_SCOPE.recommended_action: Replace wildcards with explicitly required actions and documented resources.
limitations: Explicit Deny statements are matched only on exact action strings in this prototype.

IAM_CONDITIONAL_BROAD_SCOPE.title: Broad scope limited by a declared condition
IAM_CONDITIONAL_BROAD_SCOPE.why_it_matters: A broad statement is present, but a condition narrows when it applies.
IAM_CONDITIONAL_BROAD_SCOPE.potential_impact: The effective reach depends on the condition being evaluated correctly by the provider.
IAM_CONDITIONAL_BROAD_SCOPE.recommended_action: Verify the condition is enforced as intended and consider narrowing the resource scope.
limitations: Conditions are recorded as evidence but are not evaluated against live request context.

IAM_REQUIREMENTS_UNDECLARED.title: Required actions not declared for identity
IAM_REQUIREMENTS_UNDECLARED.why_it_matters: Without declared requirements, excess privilege cannot be assessed.
IAM_REQUIREMENTS_UNDECLARED.potential_impact: Excess permissions may exist without being detected.
IAM_REQUIREMENTS_UNDECLARED.recommended_action: Declare the required_actions list for this identity and rescan.
limitations: Remediation requires declared requirements; none are generated without them.

EXPOSED_PATH_TO_SENSITIVE.title: Verified configuration path from exposed entry point to sensitive resource
EXPOSED_PATH_TO_SENSITIVE.why_it_matters: Every edge on the path is supplied and validated in the input, so the configuration connects an exposed entry point to a sensitive resource.
EXPOSED_PATH_TO_SENSITIVE.potential_impact: This is a verified configuration path, not proof of exploitability. Reaching the resource would still require an attacker to use the identity.
EXPOSED_PATH_TO_SENSITIVE.recommended_action: Review whether the identity needs access to the sensitive resource and whether the entry point should use it.
limitations: Configuration paths are not exploitability proofs.
Runtime controls outside the input are not modelled.

POSSIBLE_RELATIONSHIP_UNVERIFIED.title: Possible identity-to-sensitive-resource relationship without validated evidence
POSSIBLE_RELATIONSHIP_UNVERIFIED.why_it_matters: A relationship exists in the input but is not validated, so the access path cannot be confirmed.
POSSIBLE_RELATIONSHIP_UNVERIFIED.potential_impact: If the relationship is real, the identity may reach a sensitive resource. Evidence is missing.
POSSIBLE_RELATIONSHIP_UNVERIFIED.recommended_action: Validate the policy trace for this relationship before relying on it.
limitations: Unvalidated relationships are not used in verified paths.

AUDIT_PUBLIC_ACCESS_CHANGE.title: Audit event enabled or changed public access
AUDIT_PUBLIC_ACCESS_CHANGE.why_it_matters: A successful change that adds public access is a suspicious indicator that should be reviewed.
AUDIT_PUBLIC_ACCESS_CHANGE.potential_impact: If unauthorised, the change may have exposed data. It may also be an approved change.
AUDIT_PUBLIC_ACCESS_CHANGE.recommended_action: Confirm the change was approved with the actor and change record.
limitations: A policy-change event is an indicator, not proof of compromise.

AUDIT_PERMISSION_CHANGE.title: Audit event modified an identity's permissions
AUDIT_PERMISSION_CHANGE.why_it_matters: A successful permission change can widen access and deserves review.
AUDIT_PERMISSION_CHANGE.potential_impact: Unexpected permission changes can precede misuse of an identity.
AUDIT_PERMISSION_CHANGE.recommended_action: Confirm the change against the approved change record and compare current permissions.
limitations: A policy-change event is an indicator, not proof of compromise.

AUDIT_DENIED_REQUEST.title: Denied request recorded
AUDIT_DENIED_REQUEST.why_it_matters: A denied request was blocked. It is not a successful access event.
AUDIT_DENIED_REQUEST.potential_impact: Repeated denied requests may indicate probing. A single denial is usually normal.
AUDIT_DENIED_REQUEST.recommended_action: Review only if denials repeat or target sensitive resources.
limitations: A single unfamiliar source IP is not proof of malicious activity.

AUDIT_MISSING_CONTEXT.title: Audit event missing actor, resource, or timestamp
AUDIT_MISSING_CONTEXT.why_it_matters: Events without context cannot be fully attributed or ordered.
AUDIT_MISSING_CONTEXT.potential_impact: Activity may be unattributed, which limits investigation.
AUDIT_MISSING_CONTEXT.recommended_action: Improve audit logging so events carry actor, resource, and timestamp.
limitations: Confidence for this event is reduced.

AUDIT_UNDECLARED_ACTOR_SENSITIVE.title: Successful access to sensitive resource by undeclared actor
AUDIT_UNDECLARED_ACTOR_SENSITIVE.why_it_matters: The actor does not appear in the declared identities but succeeded in reading a sensitive resource.
AUDIT_UNDECLARED_ACTOR_SENSITIVE.potential_impact: Access may be legitimate but undocumented, or it may indicate an unmanaged credential.
AUDIT_UNDECLARED_ACTOR_SENSITIVE.recommended_action: Identify the actor and confirm it is authorised.
limitations: The configuration may be incomplete, so an undeclared actor is not proof of misuse.
